title: Welcome to Nashville!
description:
Welcome to this cozy cottage house in the trendy East Nashville area. You will be 2 miles from downtown!
You will be less than 5 minutes from most of the major attractions in Nashville! 5 points is 10 blocks away, along with all of the great restaurants and bars in East Nashville. 2 Miles from the stadium/Broadway. Includes 4k HDR OLED TV.

The space
-This house has a tankless water heater.   Everyone gets hot showers!
-Driveway parking for 2 full-size cars/trucks.
-EV Outlet in parking area (250v 40Amp)
-LG 55" 4k HDR Oled TV!
-150Mbps Wifi!
-Hulu + Live TV, Local + 140 channels
-Disney+ no commercials
-Netflix no commercials 4k HDR

No check out chores! I just ask you to clean the dishes / start the dishwasher!
Flexible check-in times! As long as another guest is not coming or going the same day, take your time getting out or get in early! Let me know, and we will see what we can work out.
The space is very well laid out and comfortable.
There maybe minor chips in modern stoneware plates/mugs.

Guest access
You will have access to the whole house!
